up: For all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649964, return their ChEMBL IDs, canonical SMILES, and the exact activity values including the relation, value, and units. Include compounds even if they have no structure available.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM assays ass
JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649964'
  AND a.standard_relation IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
